notablePrerequisites: Opponents are unable to block Wanderwine prophets.
description:
Cast Wanderwine Prophets by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Wanderwine Prophets enters the battlefield, triggering Inalla and Wanderwine Prophets.
Resolve Inalla's trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Wanderwine Prophets.
Token copy of Wanderwine Prophets enters the battlefield, championing original Wanderwine Prophets.
Resolve the Wanderwine Prophets trigger, does nothing.
Move to combat.
Declare token copy of Wanderwine Prophets as attacker.
Deal combat damage with Wanderwine Prophets.
Token copy of Wanderwine Prophets triggers, causing you to sacrifice itself and take an extra turn after this one.
Token copy of Wanderwine Prophets leaves the battlefield, returning Wanderwine Prophets to the battlefield from exile.
Repeat step 2 to 5.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat from step 6.
